{{Infobox Effect
|quote=<translate><!--T:1--> One lucky fighter on the server carries the legendary rage.</translate>
|Type=<translate><!--T:2--> Character effect (buff)</translate>
|Source=<translate><!--T:3--> The Mutant lottery, or an admin command</translate>
|Duration=<translate><!--T:4--> Until death (by default)</translate>
|Effect=<translate><!--T:5--> +25% TP gain, +50% form mastery gain, rage meter for the Legendary forms</translate>
}}
<translate>
<!--T:6-->
A '''Mutant''' is one of the server's rare chosen fighters. The '''Mutant''' effect speeds up your Training Point and form mastery gain and gives you a '''rage meter''' that lets you tap into your race's '''Legendary''' transformation line, even forms you haven't unlocked yet. Mutants are picked at random by a server lottery.
</translate>

<translate>
== Benefits == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
With the default settings, a Mutant gets:

<!--T:9-->
* '''+25% Training Point gain''' (×1.25);
* '''+50% form mastery gain''' (×1.5);
* a '''rage meter''' (see below).

<!--T:10-->
See [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Points and Mastery|Training Points and Mastery]].
</translate>

<translate>
== The rage meter == <!--T:11-->

<!--T:12-->
* The meter fills while you fight worthy opponents: dealing or taking significant hits. Mixing melee, strike and ki attacks fills it faster.
* It drains when you stay out of combat. Death resets it.
* With a '''full''' meter, you can transform into Legendary forms you don't own yet. A borrowed form is worth your best unlocked non-legendary form, with its mastery, '''+0.5''' to each stat bonus, but never more than the Legendary form itself at full mastery.
* A full meter inside a Legendary form turns into '''active rage''' for '''10 seconds'''. While it lasts, the Legendary forms you '''do''' own get '''33%''' more bonus power.
* When the rage ends, borrowed forms revert down to your highest owned form, or to base.

<!--T:13-->
The meter has its own element on the HUD (see [[Special:MyLanguage/HUD|HUD]]). See [[Special:MyLanguage/Transformations|Transformations]] for the Legendary forms.
</translate>

<translate>
== The Mutant lottery == <!--T:14-->

<!--T:15-->
* By default the server runs a '''lottery every 30 minutes'''. Each roll picks an online player with a '''20% chance''', with up to '''1 Mutant on the server at a time'''. Becoming a Mutant is a rare, random event.
* The Mutant status is '''lost on death''' by default. Dying frees the slot, so the lottery can pick a new holder.
</translate>

<translate>
== Commands == <!--T:16-->

<!--T:17-->
Admins can grant or revoke it directly with <code>/dmzeffect give mutant -1 &lt;player&gt;</code> and <code>/dmzeffect remove mutant &lt;player&gt;</code> (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Effects#Commands|Effects]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Commands|Commands]]).
</translate>
